about: A first source-bounded, project-owned restatement of content evidenced by the official Goethe-Zertifikat A2 adult model set and A2 word list. It is deliberately partial: the task samples and approximately 1,300-item lexical list provide useful finite evidence, but this file does not yet enumerate the entire lexical list or a source-closed grammar and phonology construct.

communicative-functions.note: The official model set supplies concrete reading, listening, writing, and speaking purposes, but a sample paper is not a closed inventory of every A2 communicative function.

grammar.note: The word list contains example language and structural evidence, but it does not publish a finite, complete grammar syllabus; the grammar points below remain a reviewable first tranche.

phonology-orthography.note: The model tasks require intelligible listening, speaking, and written production, but the source does not enumerate a complete A2 sound, spelling, or punctuation inventory.

lexicon.note: Goethe publishes an approximately 1,300-unit A2 word list and domain groups. This tranche records the domain boundaries but does not reproduce or probe every lexical unit, so the dimension remains partial.

probeSemantics: A point counts as COVERED only when every atom in `probe` is introduced by some German lesson. `probe: null` means the current corpus has no atom precise enough to substantiate the point. A domain heading or one example word never proves an entire lexical domain.
